completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3036_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 条号自第 2 条起而非自 1 起（止于第 3 条）：本法为“修改型法条”，仅重述被修改的个别条文，条号承被修改法之后，属该体例使然。

text.en:
Sub-section sixteen of Section one hundred forty-nine of the same Code is amended to read as follows:
"16. When there are two or more candidates for an office with the same name and/or surname, the voter shall, in order that his vote may be counted, add the correct name, surname or initial that will identify the candidate for whom he votes: Provided , That when two or more candidates have the same surname and one of them is seeking reelection, a ballot wherein only such surname is written shall be counted in favor of the candidate seeking reelection."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961
